queries.query: "large language model" network configuration generation OR "network configuration" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Locate primary papers and demos where LLMs generate device configs or CLI commands for NetOps to understand scope and reported failure modes.

queries.query: LLM NetOps OR "Generative AI" "Network Operations" OR AIOps
queries.rationale: Survey broader application of generative models to NetOps/AIOps to map architectures, evaluated tasks, and operational claims.
Find literature and incident reports documenting hallucinations or plausibly incorrect outputs specifically affecting network correctness or safety.
Identify work on translating natural-language intent into formal network configs, including intent-based networking and parsers/schema approaches.

queries.query: "generate-validate-repair" pipeline OR "generate-then-verify" LLM network configuration repair
queries.rationale: Locate architectures that combine generation with verification and automatic repair loops applied to configs or operational plans.
source_preferences: workshops on LLM verification or AIOps

queries.query: network configuration formal verification Batfish Veriflow "header space analysis" "reachability"
queries.rationale: Collect deterministic/analytic validators and verification tools (Batfish, Header Space Analysis, Veriflow, etc.) usable as validators for LLM outputs and for defining ground-truth tests.
Find methods for LLMs that call external tools/verifiers (tool-augmented agents, ReAct, toolformer) and their applicability to NetOps verification workflows.

queries.query: constrained generation "structured output" "schema" "CFG" for network config synthesis
queries.rationale: Investigate constrained/structured-output techniques (templates, grammar-constrained decoding, program synthesis) to reduce syntactic/semantic errors in generated configs.
source_preferences: program synthesis venues (PLDI, POPL), ACL, arXiv, industry implementers

queries.query: network change planning "change plan" "rollback" "transactional config" LLM
queries.rationale: Search for work on planning multi-step network changes, atomicity/rollback mechanisms, and how generative agents propose and validate change plans.
source_preferences: networking conferences (CNSM, SIGCOMM, NSDI), arXiv, vendor docs

queries.query: benchmark NetOps AIOps "6G-Bench" OR "TSNBench" OR "OpsEval" OR "NetOps benchmark"
queries.rationale: Identify existing benchmarks/datasets for evaluating models on networking/AIOps tasks and document their scope and limitations for operational validity.
source_preferences: arXiv, conference proceedings, benchmark project pages, Zenodo/GitHub releases

queries.query: evaluation metrics network config correctness "reachability" "ACL correctness" "policy compliance" "connectivity tests"
queries.rationale: Compile candidate metrics and oracle tests used to judge correctness/safety of configurations and operational plans.
source_preferences: network verification literature, Batfish papers, NSDI/IMC/IMC workshops, arXiv

queries.query: network emulation testbeds Mininet ns-3 containerlab "configuration testing"
queries.rationale: Find simulation/emulation environments and testbeds suitable for executing and validating generated configs at scale and fidelity.
source_preferences: tool homepages/GitHub, NSDI/IMC papers, community wikis

queries.query: adversarial prompts "poisoning" "malicious config" LLM NetOps security
queries.rationale: Survey adversarial risks where LLMs produce harmful or backdoored configs and methods used to evaluate or mitigate such threats.
source_preferences: security conferences, arXiv, vendor security advisories, GitHub reports

queries.rationale: Locate literature on agentic/autonomous workflow systems for operations, their orchestration patterns, and safety analyses relevant to NetOps agents.
source_preferences: AI systems conferences (AAAI, AAMAS), arXiv, systems workshops

queries.rationale: Collect meta-evaluation studies on benchmark pitfalls (leakage, memorization, prompt sensitivity) that affect claim validity for NetOps benchmarks.
source_preferences: ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML), arXiv, reproducibility reports

queries.query: human-in-the-loop verification operator review "human oversight" NetOps LLM
queries.rationale: Find studies of operator workflows, human review interfaces, and measurable effects of human oversight on safety and correctness of automated NetOps actions.
source_preferences: HCI/CSCW venues, networking operations studies, industry case studies with artifacts

queries.query: datasets of network configurations "router configs dataset" "Cisco IOS configs" public dataset
queries.rationale: Locate public corpora of real or synthetic device configs for training/evaluation and verify licenses and provenance.
source_preferences: Zenodo, GitHub datasets, academic supplemental materials, CAIDA, dataset papers

queries.query: intent-based networking "YANG" "NETCONF" "model-driven" intent translation network management
queries.rationale: Survey model-driven and intent-based networking standards and tools (YANG/NETCONF/RESTCONF) as formal interfaces and constraints for LLM-generated outputs.
source_preferences: IETF RFCs/drafts, vendor docs, networking conferences

inclusion_criteria: Primary-source peer-reviewed articles (conferences, journals) and archival preprints with verifiable artifacts (code, data).
Tool releases and open-source repositories with reproducible examples or documentation (Batfish, Mininet, containerlab, verifier tools).
Benchmarks, datasets, and technical reports with clear provenance and identifiable stable identifiers (DOI, arXiv ID, GitHub commit/tag).
IETF RFCs, standards, and vendor technical documents when publicly accessible and cited for protocols/management interfaces (YANG/NETCONF).
Security advisories or incident reports that include reproducible evidence or linked artifacts.
Survey/meta-studies on LLM evaluation, benchmark validity, and tool-augmented LLM methods.
exclusion_criteria: Unverifiable blog posts, press releases, or marketing materials lacking reproducible artifacts or primary technical detail (unless authored by vendors with linked technical repos).
Paywalled sources for which metadata cannot be verified and which provide no accessible preprint or technical report.
Duplicate metadata entries (use canonical/primary source instead).
Opinion pieces without technical evidence or reproducible methodology.
Datasets or tool releases without license or provenance making reproduction impossible.
date_rationale: Cover foundational verification and networking work (pre-2015) when necessary, but prioritize 2019–2026 literature because generative LLM methods and tool-augmented agent techniques accelerated after 2020; ensure inclusion of the latest preprints and tool releases up to 2026 to capture current agentic-AI and NetOps intersections.
